# svelte-photoswipe

A small library that wraps [PhotoSwipe v5](https://photoswipe.com/v5/docs/) into a Svelte component.

Docs/usage example: see [mvolfik.github.io/svelte-photoswipe](https://mvolfik.github.io/svelte-photoswipe/)
